speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Regional transit depot. The checkpoint manifest matches these shipments. Every outgoing convoy feeds the occupation.

speaker: KAITO
text: We followed their supply line. Now we find where it thinks for them.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Their lights reach every doorway. Stay beneath the rail deck. I’ll keep the runoff from giving us away.

speaker: TITAN
text: Steel remembers every footstep. Keep close. I’ll take the weight where the old supports are failing.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: The communication tower assigns patrol routes across this district. Reach its relay and sever the network.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Those crates carry the same markings as the siege battery. This is how they keep every checkpoint supplied.

speaker: TITAN
text: We break the road they built for their machines. The people down there get a way through.

speaker: KAITO
text: One tower. One blind spot. Get me to the relay. We move together.
